source_layers.monthly_schedule_grid: Defines every official racecourse/date pair for the full month.
source_layers.race_list_and_deba_table: Provide A+ timetable detail when official meeting detail is available.

classification.meeting_complete: Official RaceList and required detail rows are complete for one venue-date.
classification.scheduled_pending_details: The full-month schedule contains the future meeting, but complete official detail is not available yet.
classification.no_meeting_in_target_month: The full selected month has no meeting for the venue; this is not a failure.
classification.meeting_incomplete: A past or current meeting exists, but race continuity or required A+ fields are incomplete.
classification.source_unavailable: A past or current official source route cannot be fetched safely.
classification.parser_failure: A past or current route is reachable but cannot be parsed safely.
